full_judgment: 2. The plaintiffs filed Title Suit No. 299 of 1981 in the Second Court of Munsif (now Assistant Judge), Habiganj for specific performance of contract. Out of six defendants only the Government of Bangladesh, the defendant No. 6, contested the suit. After hearing the trial Court by judgment and decree dated 29-11-1983 dismissed the suit. Being aggrieved the plaintiffs preferred Title Appeal No. 14 of 1994 and the learned Subordinate Judge (now Joint District Judge) Habiganj who heard the above appeal, by judgment and decree dated 13-4-1987 dismissed the appeal. As against that the plaintiffs filed Civil Revision No. 5 of 1988 before the High Court Division Bench at Sylhet, which on transfer to Dhaka was renumbered as Civil Revision No. 10067 of 1991. Mr. Jitendra Narayan Deb, Advocate (since deceased) was the sole lawyer for the plaintiffs before the High Court Division. On 17-8-2000 the above Civil Revision No. 10067 of 1991 appeared in the daily cause list for hearing and Mr JN Deb, the learned Advocate and also the son of Mr. Jitendra Narayan Deb, Advocate (since deceased), mentioned the matter intimating the High Court Division about the death of above Mr Jitendra Narayan Deb, Advocate, the sole lawyer of the petitioners and prayed for 2(two) weeks' time for filing fresh Vokalatnama. But the above prayer was refused and then on 20-8-2000 the Rule was discharged for default. Thereafter, the newly engaged lawyer, on obtaining the fresh Vokalatnama, filed an application on 1-11-2000 praying for restoration of the above Rule and by the impugned order dated 2-11-2000 the above prayer was rejected.
